Codex implemented in 3 attempts (attempt 1 read the contract file on the request path, attempt 2 rebuilt the validator per instance; attempt 3 builds it once at module load); full pnpm verify passed in the isolated container on the AWS test machine. At landing, [AC-B3-03d#1] (96 combinations in one test) timed out at vitest's default 5 s on the loaded test machine in 2 of 3 runs (passing in the third): the orchestrator gave that test an explicit 60 s timeout in the last test(spec) commit (no assertion change) and replayed the three implementation commits on top.
